Record notes

Four methods for testing claims, reasoning, assumptions and framework selection from authorized sources.

Version 0.2.0 includes 4 complete skill procedures. Complete reasoning and framework-selection methods; recipient corpus binding plus eight original synthetic framework examples.

Requirements: Host reasoning tools; Explicit binding file for optional helper.

License scope: MIT code; CC-BY-SA-4.0 prose. Read the packaged notices and provenance before reuse.

Install with codex plugin add reasoning-studio@working-tools after adding JonathanKHobson/working-tools-plugins, or the documented Claude Code marketplace path. Installation and tested compatibility.

This ZIP has its portable manifest at the root, preserves all referenced package files. This release includes a separate per-file hash inventory. Built from ccfc84e7affdc6a0e9990f88e92e34829403d2ff. SHA-256: bfde080bd538fe16a44debea24fca85538e30a369bd2edb4f75f7a2f2e6dd9cf.

Native marketplace distribution is separate from official OpenAI Plugin Directory publication. External provider access remains a prerequisite.
